capabilities: merge a whole note into a destination note
strip source frontmatter during whole-note merge
redirect wikilinks and embeds to the target note
sort destination candidates by title match, similarity and recency
extras: Fully offline by default; external requests happen only when the user enables them with a valid API key.
problem: Merging one note into another in Obsidian means copying text by hand and then navigating to the target note yourself.

relations.evidence: Optional TypeSafe AI (Jev): Asynchronous background semantic destination prediction with confidence badges.

summary: Merges the current note or a selected passage into a destination note and opens that destination immediately after the merge.
